title: MoralDial: A Framework to Train and Evaluate Moral Dialogue Systems via Moral Discussions

layout.note: One full-width dashed frame on top holds the RoT label and its list; below, two dashed frames side by side: the left holds one blue box with three stacked turns, the right holds two stacked green boxes with two turns each, joined to the blue box by an elbow arrow that forks.

lesson: Fill a framework diagram with the turns of one concrete dialogue: dashed titled frames name the parts, avatar-plus-box turns sit inside, and one fill colour per turn role lets the reader follow shared knowledge (here RoTs) across frames. A red cross on the link between two turns flags the mismatch that triggers the next branch.
